title: operations.inventory.count_line.discrepancy_approved
description: A manager approved a counted discrepancy (ADR-0026 §3/§6). In the same transaction this posted through `app.inventory.ledger.post_move` (kind `count`), idempotent on `count:<line_id>` — `posted_move_id` names that move. The kernel computed the actual posted delta from the *live* balance under its own lock at post time, which can differ from `counted_milli - expected_milli` if the bucket moved between the count and this approval; the resulting balance always lands on `counted_milli` exactly regardless.
